insight: Spun out of eClinicalWorks, a major US ambulatory EHR vendor; the company says 100,000+ providers now use it.
name: Sunoh.ai
tagline: Ambient AI medical scribe for clinical documentation.
description: Sunoh.ai is an ambient AI medical scribe that listens to natural patient-provider conversations and turns them into structured clinical documentation. Beyond the note, it generates a visit summary and pre-fills orders for medications, labs, imaging, and referrals, which clinicians review before signing. It is EHR-agnostic, working across Epic, Athenahealth, and Cerner, and runs on iOS, Android, iPad, and the web. Pricing is a flat $149 per user per month.
edge: Pre-fills orders for meds, labs, imaging, and referrals — not just the note — while staying EHR-agnostic across Epic, Athenahealth, and Cerner.
